name: Agallamh na Seanóarch
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Agallamh na Seanóarch is the Irish name of the text called the Colloquy of the Elders. See the entry for the Colloquy of the Elders for its account.
objective: Point the reader to the Colloquy of the Elders.
key_results: Show the Irish title and its subject.
